summary: CSS grid places items into rows and columns. In the HTML you only need a container and its child elements; the CSS decides where they go.
notes: Each <article> is one project card and one grid item.
class="featured" lets the CSS make the first card wider than the others.
The cards are in reading order in the HTML. Keep it that way so keyboard and screen reader order matches the screen.
pitfall: Adding empty <div> elements to fill grid cells. Grid places items automatically, so you do not need placeholders.
